prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 80.6%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 85.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 70.8%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.7%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Move sign-in after pet adoption', 'Move sign-in after adoption certificate completion', 'Pet care instructions screen before photo upload', 'Full-bleed choose path redesign', 'Move sign-in after pet generation waiting step']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Quick controls intro step', 'Centered sign-in layout with account recovery callout', 'Waiting screen stage redesign with desktop preview', 'Move sign-in after desktop waiting generation', 'Interactive waiting tips during pet generation', 'Grid layout redesign for pick friend screen', 'Guided custom pet photo upload flow', 'Move sign-in after pick friend step']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Add dedicated desktop controls tutorial screen', 'Preset selection preview flow for custom pet photo upload', 'Account sign-in warning copy for pet sync', 'Split layout for choose path screen', 'Adoption certificate starter accessory badge', 'Pet name input and sound effect', 'Shift certificate flow after waiting step', 'Account sync clarity copy on sign-in', 'Starter bonus reward announcement on certificate', 'Carousel interactive path selection', 'Starter pet reward highlight badge', 'Move sign-in step after home intro', 'Stage layout redesign for adoption certificate', 'Account restoration hint on sign-in screen', 'Adoption completion treat bundle highlight', 'Interactive custom photo quality checklist flow', 'Desktop control hint on home intro', 'Pet adopt incentive badge']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Reordering sign-in steps has been helpful overall (+5.1% average after noise correction), winning 3 tests while 2 showed no clear effect.
Home redesign changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests (-3.3% average after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, choose_path redesign, finish new_screen, and sign_in redesign, as only 1 test has been completed for each.
Predictions were generally overestimated for failed or neutral tests, but underestimated performance on winning tests.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Compact upload layout redesign with photo preview
candidates.change: Redesign the upload_photos screen into a compact layout with a live photo preview container to help users upload high quality pet photos easily.
candidates.why: Adoption step has high drop-off (70.8% completion, 1017s mean time) and support reported custom pet creation issues.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Your Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Add photos of your pet to help generate your custom companion.

candidates.title: Companion mascot greeting screen before desktop reveal
candidates.change: Insert a new companion greeting screen right before home_intro to introduce the pet's character.
candidates.why: Finish screen completion drops to 64.8% with high mean time (5815s), needing an engaging transition into the desktop environment.

new_pet_greeting.headline: Your Desktop Companion is Ready!
new_pet_greeting.body: Your new pet is eager to join you on your screen.

candidates.title: Story scroll intro redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the initial story screen using a story_scroll layout featuring option preview cards before path selection.
candidates.why: Mean time spent on choose_path is high (514s), indicating users take long to decide how to start.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion
story.body: Discover how you can adopt or build your custom digital friend.

candidates.title: Generation wait flow video preview
candidates.change: Enhance the waiting screen with a video asset preview showing what the pet can do on the desktop while generation completes.
candidates.why: Home target step drop-off and long waiting time (201s median) lead to user confusion during pet creation.

candidates.title: Account pet safety copy on sign-in screen
candidates.change: Update headline and body on sign_in to explicitly explain that signing in backs up the pet and prevents progress loss.
candidates.why: Support theme highlights 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Pet
sign_in.body: Linking your account ensures your pet and accessories are backed up permanently.

candidates.title: Adoption certificate progress tracking info
candidates.change: Enable progress bars and step counters on the adoption certificate screen to clarify adoption status.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion in the early funnel (70.8%).

candidates.title: Desktop pet control interactions hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit interactive hint on home_intro explaining how to click, drag, hide, or talk to the pet on desktop.
candidates.why: Support emails show confusion about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after setup.

home_intro.hint: Click your pet on the screen anytime to chat, drag to move, or right-click to minimize.

candidates.title: Path selection feature badges
candidates.change: Add emphasis and visual badges to choice options on choose_path screen highlighting instant play vs custom pet path.
candidates.why: Reduces decision friction on choose_path where mean duration reaches 514s.

candidates.title: Sign-in progress notification indicator
candidates.change: Add a progress bar and sync confirmation hint to sign_in to reassure users their pet configuration is safe.
candidates.why: 2 support emails reported sign-in stalling or screen failing to appear properly.

sign_in.hint: Your pet progress is saved. Complete sign in to finish setup.

candidates.title: Move sign-in after photo upload step
candidates.change: Reorder the sign-in step to appear immediately after pet photo upload instead of before pet creation.
candidates.why: Reordering sign-in after investment steps consistently improved conversion (+5.1% average in earlier tests).

sign_in.headline: Save Your Photo Creation
sign_in.body: Sign in now to generate and protect your custom pet.
